runSummary.goal: At least 20 water units on time, at least 3 on-time water units at EVERY home, and at most 10 total courier waiting turns. Permit either one existing bridge move or one dispatch policy change. Keep workers, demand, deadlines, production and schedule unchanged.
runSummary.summary:
Recommendation: switch dispatch policy to `balanced` — one-edit, verified.

Evidence, same seed `271026`:
- Systematic simulator search over `all` single-edits: `checked: 22`, `searchComplete: true`.
- Best candidate `Use balanced dispatch`: `goalMet: true`, contract `passed: true`, `verifiedBy: deterministic-engine-v1`.
- Metrics: `delivered 24/24`, `onTime 20/24`, `lateUnits 4`, `waitTicks 7 <= 10`, `completedAt 98`.
- Per-house on-time vs floor 3: house `photo-2` 4, `photo-4` 3, `photo-6` 3, `photo-8` 4, `photo-10` 3, `photo-11` 3 — all pass.

Baseline comparison:
- Baseline failed: `photo-6` 0/3 on-time, `waitTicks 22 > 10`.
- Fix improves: `photo-6` 0 -> 3 on-time, waiting 22 -> 7.

Tradeoff / honest remaining lateness:
- Not all-on-time: 4 late units remain, spread as 1 late unit each at `photo-4`, `photo-6`, `photo-10`, `photo-11` after tick 80.
- Houses `photo-4`, `photo-10`, `photo-11` go from 4 on-time in baseline to 3 on-time — required to lift `photo-6` to floor and cut bridge waiting. Bridge queues change from [4,4] to [4,1].
